name: example-m3-habit-app
title: Material 3 Habit Tracker
description: Material Design 3 (Material You) mobile habit-tracker home screen in a centered 420px phone frame: green tonal-seed scheme, top app bar, primary-container streak card with a 7-day dot row, habit list with M3 checkboxes and tonal icon tiles, floating action button, and pill-style bottom navigation bar. Use when the brief mentions "android app", "material you", "MD3 mobile", "habit tracker", "daily checklist app". Original work following CWTI Ltd's material-3-skill rules.

query.en: Design a Material 3 Android habit-tracker home screen — streak card, habit checklist, FAB, and bottom navigation in a phone frame.
